verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says it can "automate GL coding by entity globally" as part of daily close, alongside one-click accruals. This covers automatic, multi-entity GL assignment tied to faster close. However, the evidence is only short marketing lines and never explicitly says AI drives the GL coding. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the GL coding is AI-driven, in-depth documentation of how codes are assigned and how entity rules work, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
